decision_rule.ADMITTED: the CI95 lower bound of the paired official pooled SLU-F1 delta (CELL-2 minus PLAN) is ABOVE ZERO and the CI95 lower bound of the paired intent delta exceeds -0.9943 (owner decision 99, the TRAIN lock: a gain is proven, not merely non-inferior)
decision_rule.DELTA_CONSUMPTION: item S3-4s: the per-node delta-consumption table -- how many deltas each node was supplied per row, which value_ids were supplied, and the saves and harms on the rows that received each one -- is a PRIMARY deliverable, reported whatever the verdict, placed beside CELL-1's own table, and is what decides whether there is an iteration 3 and what it retains. The PLANNER route is reported separately, never pooled: 4 of its 14 values survive the retention and CELL-1 measured it at 0.594 of rows supplied and never at cap.
decision_rule.FRONTIER: owner decision 75: the frontier row (official SLU-F1 delta x prefilled tokens per row x GPU hours per 1,080 rows) is reported on every verdict and placed beside the registered rows.
decision_rule.HARMFUL: a MEASURED loss on either guard (owner decision 25, Method B: a CI95 upper bound below zero, or a point estimate beyond the margin); width alone is NEUTRAL, never HARMFUL
decision_rule.NEUTRAL: both guards are non-inferior -- the SLU CI95 lower bound exceeds -1.2485 and the intent CI95 lower bound exceeds -0.9943 -- without a proven SLU gain
decision_rule.PER_SCENARIO_HARM_BOUND: owner decision 17: per-scenario intent and SLU tables over all 18 scenarios in BOTH the natural-mixture and the equal-stratum weighting, with net harmed rows per scenario and any scenario of five or more flagged. A breach is a diagnostic beside the verdict, never a gate.
decision_rule.REPLICATION: an ADMITTED result is replicated on the SAME roster before any DEV, Fold B or test read (the owner iteration rule; no DEV read is authorised by this package).
decision_rule.SECOND_LOOK: CELL-2 is read on the same TRAIN Fold A rows whose CELL-1 read chose the retained set. Its verdict is a development number under owner decisions 28 and 86 and is not an independent confirmation of anything; an ADMITTED result is replicated on the same roster and then on a fresh one (Fold B or DEV) before any effectiveness claim. No such read is authorised by this package.
decision_rule.TWIN: ATTRIBUTION, never admission. The twin arm is read with the same estimator against the same sealed PLAN comparator. A gain the twin reproduces within the plan's own null is FORM (the store's shape and token volume), not content, and the verdict says so and claims no content effect. A gain the twin does not reproduce is attributed to the deltas' content, with the twin delta reported beside it.
decision_rule.comparator: the sealed PLAN arm SAEA-SLURP-NATIVE-DEFAULT-PLAN-LOCK-V1 (official 63.6304 / 82.2222); nothing is re-flown
decision_rule.efficiency_is_reported_regardless: every efficiency deliverable is reported whatever the verdict

defect_and_fix: THE FIX. The stage3-deltas store is NODE-ADDRESSED: its 379 values split into disjoint per-node slices (Perception 119, Solver 151, Reviewer 95, Planner 14), and the Reviewer slice associates with only 30 of the 39 legal intents, so a row whose Perception candidates fall outside those 30 matches no Reviewer delta at all. The pre-fix rails.knowledge_stores._stage3_delta_local_supply still returned a PhaseSupply for that row; rails.controllers.advance_phase_response_state turns ANY supply into an action_kind=acquire transition, and rails.knowledge.AgentStepTransition.validate refuses an acquire that introduces neither a value nor a facet -- so the v2 smoke died at the openJiuwen vertex reviewer_0_input after 12 metered contacts, on the two of four rows whose candidates miss the Reviewer slice. The Solver never showed it because that phase composes three supplies and a sibling always carried a value; the Reviewer and the Planner are served by this store alone. The route now supplies NOTHING when it introduces nothing new: the matching pool is ranked in full, the ids already in QueryState.retrieved_value_ids are dropped (the cumulative value set a revisited node sees), the per-node cap is applied to what REMAINS, and an empty result returns None, so the phase takes no supply step and the wave seals as an ordinary organize transition. The transition invariant stays strict; no config key was added and no decided key moved; on a first visit with nothing visible the selection is byte-identical to its pre-fix self. Each skip is receipted on the router as delta_supply {node, phase, sample_id, store_id, selected, already_acquired, reason}. PROVEN OFFLINE BEFORE THIS FLIGHT: analysis.native_episode_dry_run walks this exact composition node by node on the real released stores with zero model, tool, network, GPU, gate, transport, client or attempt contacts -- now on ALL FOUR rows, with the Perception candidate ids the v2 attempt's own trace recorded, and with the runner's own repeat-visit restriction performed in the walk. Pre-fix it reproduces the flight's own error sentence on rows 2 and 4 and completes rows 1 and 3, exactly as the flight did; post-fix all four rows complete (per-node deltas supplied: Perception 4 seeded on every row; Solver 1 / 4 / 0 / 0; Reviewer 3 / 0 / 2 / 0; Planner 1 / 0 / 1 / 0), and a REVISE walk revisits Solver, Reviewer and Planner acquiring nothing a second time. Regression: tests/unit/test_native_episode_dry_run.py (the real cell, all four rows, plus the REVISE path) and tests/unit/test_stage3_delta_supply_router.py (the router contract, the refused empty acquire that the ladder used to pin as "an empty but valid supply", and the cap applied to new values).

prepared_phase_supply.note: Item E16: a prepared artifact is evidence only for the implementation that produced it, so each of the four flown cells prepares its OWN first-phase Perception supply under its OWN run id at the readiness flip. core.flight.repin.ensure_artifact_pinned runs core.flight.cli prepare-supply (model-free, zero model / tokenizer / encoder / scorer / server contacts), writes the pin into the baseline fragment and inserts the matching 'preparation' readiness requirement. The committed baselines therefore carry NO prepared_phase_supply key at all -- the cell-P0 form (scripts/flights/batch/derive_plan_cell_registration.py drops it for exactly this reason). A PENDING_ string in its place is NOT a valid registration: core.flight.repin.ArtifactPin.from_mapping refuses it ('malformed artifact pin') before the preparation step can run, which is the defect this registration repaired.

repin_obligation: RE-PIN OBLIGATION. rails/knowledge_stores.py is one of the five files whose SHA-256 is part of every prepared phase-supply artifact identity (core.flight.runtime._phase_seed_inputs), so this fix invalidates the pinned first-phase artifact of EVERY CELL-2 cell. The coordinator re-pins each of them with scripts/flights/repin_cell.py, which re-runs the model-free prepare-supply step; their output is expected to reproduce byte for byte, because the change moves no first-phase selection (the unconditional Perception route is untouched), and --allow-output-change must never be passed. This cell carries no committed prepared_phase_supply pin at all, so the re-pin MINTS its own under its own run id (item E16). The offline dry run of this composition already reports 'router-bootstrap (pinned artifact refused: prepared artifact identity mismatch)' on the retired v2 cell for exactly this reason, with the same 12 seeded value ids.
